description.narrative: The principal objective of the Project is to assist the Ministry of Municipalities and Public Works (MMPW) to restore basic water supply, sanitation and urban services for urban areas outside Baghdad through (a) the reconstruction and rehabilitation of existing priority networks and treatment facilities; and (b) providing capacity building support through training and technical assistance.
